name: Christel Schaldemose - § 28 - Am 3
title: REPORT on the protection of minors online
part_text: 28. Recognises the diverse perspectives among Member States regarding appropriate age limits for access to online social media platforms, for video-sharing services and AI companions; stresses that establishing digital age limits remains within the remit of Member States; calls for any age limits to be determined in consultation with child development experts and psychologists; recognises that while a coordinated European approach regarding an age limit of 13 could be beneficial, Member States should retain the flexibility to set appropriate thresholds based on expert guidance and their own cultural, educational and parental approaches, with provisions allowing minors to access platforms with parental or guardian authorisation; stresses that such measures would serve to support parents in managing their children’s digital presence and ensuring age-appropriate online engagement;
